name: frontend-mastery-skills
description: Front-end designer skills for Cursor and other coding agents: scan, audit, build, judge independently, gate, learn.

scripts.setup: npm i && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:selftest && npm run grade -- --strict
